latestVersion.changelog:
generator-online-free v1.0.0

- Initial release of an online tool for AI-powered video generation and export.
- Supports uploading MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG files up to 500MB for automatic video creation.
- No installation or payment required; includes free credits with anonymous signup.
- Handles requests for exporting videos, checking credits, uploading files, and AI video edits.
- Automatic session management and API integration, with clear user feedback on status and errors.
- Designed for content creators and marketers needing instant, shareable videos.
